title: Nonhuman cheats: full reveal/grant palette, strong powers and real supplier boundaries
head: b6678ea9ba4a7cf0313ce83e0c0fc6b0e5c26d5b

reviews.classification: Full cheat palette; disclosure, supplier, effect and durable settlement separated
reviews.disposition:
F1. Full review covers CN-F1–F7, all sixteen CN-S readings, twelve CN-G operations, six CN-A openings, ten CN-I combinations/six profiles, twelve CN-SB knacks, six CN-E groups, five CN-UI/CN-V rows, eight CN-C considerations and five CN-P suggestions. These are composable aspects, not sixteen compulsory panels or new duplicate body/relationship/cargo stores. Held-card acquisition/backing/activation and narrow typed configuration remain distinct from actual body, knowledge, custody, job and relationship authority. A valid JSON card or capability amount does not itself admit a new anatomy, execute a cheat hook or publish a native function.

F2. A status window displays an earned reading; it does not raise appraisal depth by rendering a label. Ordinary senses and player save/pause/settings controls do not require a system card. Self facts, stranger appraisal, actual remote samples and simulated previews have different suppliers/observers/timestamps. Loss of a live source need not erase honestly attributed historical observations. Translation is not truth detection, understanding is not acceptance, a name is not ownership, and observing a partner is not switching control. Exact semantic/truth/identity powers can nevertheless reveal what their actual mechanism supports, rather than being artificially weakened to ordinary cues under AD38.

F3. Keep the disclosure route intact across visible prose, tooltips, accessible names, hidden DOM, branch existence and denial reasons. A legitimately successful in-game discovery can expose its supported result; a report/public share card cannot accidentally expose changed authored truth. Actual gameplay export remains available and is not falsely promised to be a spoiler-redacted public card. Observation samples need meaningful receipt identity rather than new facts generated every render. Store only what the selected consumer needs; the proposed observer/target/field/means/channel/basis tuple is illustrative, not an allocated current save schema.

F4. Absorption stages, advice/execution, blueprint/instance, person/body/controller, owner/occupant, memory grant and bodily mastery remain distinct unless an actual stronger mechanism joins them. Legitimate unlimited forms, free repair, parallel minds, amplified naming channels, multiplier rewards, repeatable growth or a selected world reset remain possible under AD22/AD38. Prevent replaying one cause twice rather than banning two real uses. Prepared next-life options preserve actual source/recipient history without fabricated memories. The first harmless absorption consumer does not require a full possession/parallel-body/naming engine; a small reader does not require all generic hooks.

F5. Durable write then publication separates precommit failure from postcommit UI failure: the latter does not refund a committed grant, reveal, specimen or naming event. Historical CH1 closure, first-win evidence, audited publish-before-save risks and bounded Tern support are attributed, not freshly reproduced or newly repaired here. Old1366-primary/current-pilot/milestone and closed-browser-policy references require current owners. Apply current desktop prose-first context and AD36/AD43 to the selected result; AD42 keeps human review optional. Under AD32 all palette, field and ranking choices remain proposals. Source locators, WN member identities, private-summary/translation limits and unresolved foreign-world formulas retain their original scope; no primary-book, runtime, migration, UI or persistence proof is added.
reviews.evidence: Entire361-line input delivered in ranges1–130,131–245,246–361. Links/code/dossiers remain attributed historical evidence, not fresh proof.
reviews.reopen: Selected status/appraisal/grant or cross-life consumer changes; inspect actual supplier and settlement semantics without turning all aspects into a prerequisite engine.
